name: Pirtobrutinib (non-covalent BTK inhibitor)

institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard-of-care dosing (experimental; owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: Continuous oral therapy until progression or intolerance; the cycle count is a 28-day accounting frame.
Retains activity after covalent BTK-inhibitor failure, including with BTK C481 resistance mutations.
Antiviral and other infection prophylaxis per risk.
Review antithrombotic co-medication and bleeding risk.
monitoring: CBC periodically; watch for cytopenias and infection
Blood pressure and rhythm review; atrial fibrillation risk appears lower than with covalent agents but still monitored

doseModificationRules.text: Hold until recovery and resume at a reduced step per standard practice; physician decides.

drugs.name: Pirtobrutinib
drugs.notes: Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita, general reference): 200 mg by mouth once daily, taken continuously until progression or intolerance. A non-covalent (reversible) BTK inhibitor used after progression on or intolerance to a covalent BTK inhibitor. dosePerUnit is the single daily 200 mg dose. Own wording; not copied from any source.
